ar.title: مصاصات الفاكهة المجمّدة
ar.intro:

اصنع طبقتين: عصير برتقال ثم عصير فراولة.

steps.n1: قطّع الفراولة قطعاً صغيرة بسكين الزبدة.

en.title: Fruit Ice Pops
en.intro:
Colourful pops made of juice and fruit pieces, for hot days.

Make two layers: orange juice, then strawberry juice.

steps.n1: Cut the strawberries into small pieces with a butter knife.
steps.n2: A grown-up peels and cuts the kiwi.
steps.n3: Drop the fruit pieces into the moulds.
steps.n4: Pour in the juice almost to the top.
steps.n5: Push in the sticks or the mould lid.
steps.n7: Hold the mould under warm water for a few seconds so the pops slide out.

legacySteps: Cut the strawberries into small pieces with a butter knife.
A grown-up peels and cuts the kiwi.
Drop the fruit pieces into the moulds.
Pour in the juice almost to the top.
Push in the sticks or the mould lid.
Hold the mould under warm water for a few seconds so the pops slide out.
